intro: Everything people usually ask before they give, volunteer or join a program. Can't find yours? Talk to us.

contact.title: Still have questions?
contact.description: Our team replies to every message within one working day.

faqs.question: How do I know my donation reaches children?
faqs.answer: Every donation is tracked from the moment it arrives. We publish an annual report showing where the money went, and each program page shows its funding progress.

faqs.question: Can I give to one specific program?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose Education, Meals, Healthcare or Clean Water when you donate and your gift goes only to that program.

faqs.question: Can I set up a monthly gift?
faqs.answer: You can. Monthly gifts help us plan ahead, and you can change, pause or cancel yours at any time.

faqs.question: Will I get a receipt for my donation?
faqs.answer: Every donation gets an emailed receipt. Tax benefits depend on the law where you live, so please check with your tax adviser.

faqs.question: How do I become a volunteer?
faqs.answer: Fill in the volunteer form, tell us when you are free and what you enjoy doing, and our coordinator will match you with a team and call you within a week.

faqs.question: Do I need any special skills?
faqs.answer: No. We need cooks, drivers, teachers and helpers, and we train every volunteer before the first shift.

faqs.question: How do you choose where to work?
faqs.answer: We work with village leaders, schools and local volunteers to find the biggest gaps, then start where a small gift makes the biggest difference.
